verdict.rationale: cfo.ai explicitly says a CSV upload is "a first-class way in, not a fallback" [docs-13]. The docs also describe connecting a Google Sheet, or an Excel or CSV file in Google Drive, which Ari imports into the Model and updates when the file changes [docs-17]. Ari can also rebuild an existing workbook as a live Model [docs-4]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth docs on direct local-file upload (column mapping, formats, limits) beyond short one-line claims.
